This document describes the required plan and research for the implementation of the SAS to PySpark transpiler, focusing on the parser, intermediate representation (IR), and code generator development.

## Plan and Research
The first stage of the project is to come up with a detailed plan of the implementation, the implementation (parser and code generator) can only happen afterwards. The plan and research should focus on:
- Ask for uncertainties in the specification
- Propose appropriate IRs (possibly multiple options)
- Lay out the steps for the implementation of the parser
- Lay out the steps for the implementation of the code generator
- Come up with an appropriate iterative validation mechanism
